elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3 applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance at Customer's request.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor returns all Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires Vendor, within thirty days of expiry or termination, to return all Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning the Customer Data, Vendor deletes it from its systems.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor to “thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies the deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor to certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3 applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) makes requested transition assistance available for up to six months, which encompasses the fallback ninety-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires Vendor to return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days, satisfying the data-export requirement.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only the transition-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification obligations needed by the rule, while leaving the existing delivery and refund provisions unchanged. The drafting is clear, appropriately triggered, and directionally assigns each obligation to Vendor.
